slides.texte_overlay:
how to become unbelievably
articulate and well spoken

pause instead of filling

replace every um and like with a short, calm pause. silence sounds thoughtful, filler words sound unsure, and people slowly start hanging on your every word.

summarise in one line

before you answer any question, decide your one line answer first, then add detail. starting with the point makes you sound clear, calm and confident.

learn a new idea daily

spend 5 minutes a day learning one new idea: a word's origin, a scientific concept, a moment in history. articulate people simply have more to talk about.
slides.texte_sophia:
learn a new idea daily

i spend 5 minutes a day learning one new idea: a word's origin, a scientific concept. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and articulate people simply have more to say.

slides.texte_overlay:
read aloud

read a page of a good book out loud every evening. it trains your mouth to handle long sentences and quietly fills your memory with richer, better words.

record and listen

record yourself answering one question a week and listen back. you'll hear exactly what to fix, and you'll also discover you already sound far better than you expect.
